title: Suspicious Citrix NetScaler Gateway access from external source - BROAD
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Detects suspicious external access to Citrix NetScaler Gateway authentication surfaces consistent with CVE-2025-5777 probing or exploitation. Covers scanner and automation tool User-Agents on any Gateway endpoint, and POST requests to the specific exploit endpoints regardless of User-Agent, catching attackers who spoof a legitimate browser UA.
